_meta.source: https://roautomation.dev/ (public marketing site, Next.js 15.5.27 / React 19.2 app router, one stylesheet scope .v2)
_meta.purpose: Reference only, to match the RoAutomation app UI in Agent HQ. Not for redistribution.

provenance_legend.exact-css: literal value in the shipped CSS bundle (css/53a72c7d... and siblings)
provenance_legend.measured-pixels: sampled from the lossy WebP app/phone screenshots on the site; +-4 per channel, edges blurred. Treat as approximate.
provenance_legend.skeleton-css: literal CSS of the .v2-dsk loading skeleton that mimics the real app layout; layout numbers are real, colours are close
provenance_legend.inferred: derived by comparing the above; not directly observed

extra_scoped_custom_properties.--c: per-element tint, drives .v2-tile / .v2-chip / .v2-amb via color-mix(in srgb, var(--c) N%, ...)
extra_scoped_custom_properties.--i: index, used for staggered delay in lists
extra_scoped_custom_properties.--v2-turn: 360deg animated @property-style angle for the featured plan conic border (10s linear infinite)

variants.featured_plan_border_conic: conic-gradient(from var(--v2-turn),#8b7cff,#d77cf0,#ff8a6b,#d77cf0,#8b7cff) masked to a 1px ring, 10s linear infinite

brand_gradient.uses: text-gradient accent on greeting name (phone), plan badge, featured plan border, buttons in app

lead.label: Lead
lead.role: Your AI manager. You talk to it, and it runs the team.

pulse.label: Pulse
pulse.role: Reads the Roblox charts and pitches games while they’re still rising.

architect.label: Architect
architect.role: Turns the pitch into a full design and a build plan.

builder.label: Builder
builder.role: Codes the game in Roblox Studio and makes every build.

frame.label: Frame
frame.role: Menus, UI and the juice that makes every click land.

scenic.label: Scenic
scenic.role: Terrain, lighting and creatures in motion.

playtest.label: Playtest
playtest.role: Plays it in Studio and on a phone, finds what broke and gets it fixed.

kid-playtester.label: Mobile Tester
kid-playtester.role: Plays every build on phones, PC and a gamepad, and checks every screen.

balance.label: Balance
balance.role: tunes the economy so players stay

agent_tile_recipe.provenance: inferred (hue pairs exact from site JS data; 135deg direction and gloss measured from app pixels)
agent_tile_recipe.css: linear-gradient(135deg, hue[0], hue[1]) with an inner 1px top highlight; icon glyph white, outline style (lucide)
agent_tile_recipe.marketing_chip_recipe: .v2-tile: color=color-mix(var(--c) 80%, #fff); bg=color-mix(var(--c) 24%, #0c0d12); border=1px color-mix(var(--c) 48%, transparent); shadow=inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(var(--c) 36%, transparent), 0 8px 22px -10px color-mix(var(--c) 60%, transparent)
agent_tile_recipe.chip: .v2-chip: height 24, radius 999, 12px/600, color color-mix(var(--c) 62%, #fff), bg color-mix(var(--c) 13%, transparent), border 1px color-mix(var(--c) 32%, transparent)

page_layout.nav: fixed, top 14px, width min(1240px, 100% - 28px), height 60, radius 18, padding 0 10px 0 20px, gap 18, bg rgba(12,13,18,.55) -> .78 when scrolled, border 1px var(--line), backdrop blur(20px) saturate(1.5), z 50
page_layout.noise_overlay: fixed full-screen feTurbulence svg 160px tile, opacity .045, z 100

font_files.note: Geist Variable + Geist Mono Variable, woff2 variable (100-900), 11 @font-face subsets; latin subsets loaded

typography.weight_note: Variable font: odd weights are used (520, 540, 550, 560, 620, 640, 650, 680). Round to nearest 100 only if the font is not variable.

autoplay_observed_dwell_seconds.hero app tabs (dock): about 6-7 per tab (4.1, 10.1, 17.2, 23.3 then loop); progress bar under active tab, scaleX driven by JS
autoplay_observed_dwell_seconds.stops_on_click: unverified (clicks pinned a tab in walk, autoplay resumed was not tested)

capture_geometry.desktop_png: 1920x1200 = a 1280x800 CSS-px window at 1.5 DPR. Divide screenshot pixels by 1.5 to get the app CSS px (sidebar 372 -> 248).
capture_geometry.phone_png: 1170x2289 = 390x763 CSS px at 3 DPR. Divide by 3.
capture_geometry.window_chrome_on_site: .v2-glass frame, 26px radius, 10px padding; fake traffic lights and title "RoAutomation - Nova Games" in mono; this chrome is the website, not the app

layout_css_px.shell_background: radial-gradient(1200px 700px at -10% -20%, rgba(124,107,255,.12), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(900px 600px at 110% -10%, rgba(255,122,154,.06), transparent 55%), #08090d

sidebar_nav_item.active: tinted violet pill with 1px lighter violet border and a 3-4px gradient accent bar on the far-left window edge

layout_css_px.sidebar_section_labels: WORKSPACE / STUDIO / TEAM: 10-11px uppercase, tracked, colour about #767981

topbar.left: All games selector pill + count badge, slash, page title
topbar.right: Live status pill, Refresh numbers, New task (brand gradient)

tabs_row.note: skeleton only; real tab rows appear on Review and Pitches with a 2px gradient underline

colors_measured.pitches_hero_card_gradient: left #383222 -> mid #262e26 -> right #13191d (card tinted by the pitch cover colour, fades to card bg)

brand_gradient_measured.provenance: measured-pixels across New task button; more saturated and pinker at the end than the site --grad (#ff8a6b)

agent_tiles_measured.state_rings: working = green ring (Builder, Frame), queued = blue ring (Librarian, Scenic, Kid Tester); ring about 2px with 2px gap; idle = no ring
agent_tiles_measured.size: sidebar 28px, live list row 28px (42 in png), card icon 36px (54 in png) radius about 10px, Lead header icon 44px radius 12px (png 66px)

app_font.observation: The app mock text is a neo-grotesque; body resembles Inter. Display headings (Good evening, Needs you) show a u-shaped y that differs from Geist and from standard Inter. Monospace for Ctrl K. The marketing site itself uses Geist Variable / Geist Mono Variable.
app_font.action: Do not assume Geist for the app. Needs a higher-res capture or the owner to confirm which UI font the real app uses.
